what: Verified live Mac browser webcam capture through Hub to the project editor. Added headset runtime checks and optical hand joint selection.
why: Performers can choose a familiar camera permission surface and see when the webcam is successfully solving their pose.
details: The live camera published 65 poses in 65 frames. Unreal evaluated the last frame with 23 bones. The Quest separately supplied 67 joints; independent finger-curl motion, simultaneous live capture and station registration still need a rehearsal.
